summary: The TUI accepts FRACTAL_PERSON, FRACTAL_ENDPOINT and FRACTAL_DOWNLOADS while continuing to read ST3_PERSON, ST3_ENDPOINT and ST3_DOWNLOADS. Unequal non-empty aliases report an error without exposing their values. Demo playback excludes both configuration spellings; the phone client and interaction QA accept both names too.

replay.detail: No stored data changes or replay.

compatibility.detail: Old environment names remain readable. New names are preferred, empty values are ignored, and conflicting non-empty values must be made equal or one unset. Producers are unchanged.

manual.detail: Existing single-name configurations need no changes.
